definitions.denominator: All player Pass, Shot and Dribble events in periods 1–2, including added time. Carries and receptions are excluded to avoid counting consecutive representations of the same action.
definitions.non_penalty_shots: Shot events whose shot.type is not Penalty. Includes free-kick shots.
definitions.completed_takeons: Dribble events with dribble.outcome = Complete. Not carries.
definitions.shot_assists: Pass events with an assisted_shot_id linking to an actual Shot in the same match. Includes passes assisting goals; no inferred assists.
definitions.passes_into_box: Pass events without a pass.outcome (StatsBomb completion convention), starting outside and ending inside x≥102, 18≤y≤62 on the StatsBomb 120×80 pitch. Includes set plays.
definitions.forward_passes: Completed passes ending at least 10 StatsBomb x-units farther toward the opposition goal. This custom definition is NOT the synthetic wheel’s 25% distance-reduction rule.
definitions.rates: 100 × summed qualifying events / summed Pass+Shot+Dribble events. Pool counts first, never average match percentages.

coverage: Selected 2003/04 Premier League matches against Arsenal: Lampard 2, Gerrard 2, Scholes 1. NOT season or career averages.
limitations: One opponent, very small unequal reference samples; tactical and opponent selection effects are not removed.
The percentages are a descriptive least-squares fit within these three samples, not probabilities, ability ratings or validated career-style similarity.
All five axes use counts per 100 Pass+Shot+Dribble events, with equal weight per rate point. Metrics can overlap.
A poor fit or unstable weights can mean the target is outside this reference set. No claim that these three players span all midfield styles.
Future events do not enter earlier snapshots. Half-end selections include added time.
Counts are reproducible from the pinned source; no independent second-provider event audit has been performed.
